title: Outis Local Pilot File and Folder Architecture

document_role.ratification_gate: This document is normative only through Sections 37 and 40 of the working specification. The S1-21 author pre-audit and peer audit passed, and P1-01 is approved. File creation and removal remain blocked until the amended plan is committed on a clean baseline and followed by the exact S1-21 offline preflight.

architecture_rules.primary_rule: Every production file has one semantic responsibility and one owning runtime or evidence surface.
architecture_rules.dependency_direction: macOS app -> generated FFI contract -> outis-ffi -> outis-runtime -> outis-core
rules: outis-core must not depend on Swift, macOS frameworks, a model runtime, a database engine, Keychain, or FFI.

outis-runtime owns approved local Rust side effects and concrete adapters; native Word/PDF/OCR remains in the macOS application target; no separate adapter crate is created without measured compile or isolation need.
outis-ffi owns only the language boundary and must not duplicate domain behavior.
The macOS application owns user interaction and platform access; it must not reimplement Rust transformation rules.
Synthetic fixtures, evaluation code, benchmarks, generated bindings, and model artifacts remain outside production source targets.
No file or directory is created as an empty placeholder.
No path for Finder, remote services, RAG, rendering, or post-quantum services is created in the first slice.

Rust runtime owns strict .txt and .md extraction; the single macOS application target owns small AppKit Word, PDFKit PDF, Core Graphics render, and Vision OCR adapters; no format-specific crate or extra Xcode target is created.

Every successfully processed source maps to exactly one .md target under a separate outis root; target paths preserve the source-relative structure and base names only after sensitive component tokenization.

approved_s1_bindings.decision: Approved: Rust strict UTF-8 extraction; AppKit Word import; PDFKit PDF text and access checks; Core Graphics 200-DPI rendering; Vision revision 3 accurate OCR with ordered Italian, German, and French languages, automatic language detection, language correction disabled, and sequential pages; mandatory embedded Quick Look binary review with exact hash-bound confirmation; normalized-document and provenance schemas; limits; failures; fixtures; and validation commands.

Approved for the synthetic demo: the R1.1 exact NER candidate and R1 address assembler; qualified legal clearance remains a model-specific implementation, execution, packaging, distribution, and complete-acceptance blocker only.
Approved: rusqlite 0.40.2 with bundled SQLite 3.53.2, one connection, exact PRAGMAs, schema, migration, permissions, deletion, and synthetic-only plaintext-vault limitation.
Approved: no Keychain item or vault secret exists in the synthetic funding demo; confidential-data use remains blocked pending encrypted-vault research.

Approved: Rust repr(C) as ABI source, cbindgen 0.29.4 for generated/ffi/outis.h, a reviewed source module map, staticlib linking, UTF-8 JSON wire schemas, polling, outis_job_submit_extraction with separate bounded plaintext text and provenance buffers, and release ownership.

Approved: the fixed export and staging names, first-publish rename, RENAME_SWAP-only replacement, sync, cancellation, cleanup, and last-valid-output behavior; failure injection remains required before readiness claims.

approval_effect: S1-18 accepts the final architecture allowlist, S1-19 partitions the model legal gate, S1-20 narrows the first pre-model increment to exact MI-01 paths, and S1-21 binds its installed stable alias to exact local toolchain evidence without authorizing work. The S1-21 author pre-audit, repeated peer audit, and approved MI-01 implementation plan remain mandatory before any code change; qualified legal clearance additionally gates every model-specific surface.
